items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: I used to play with him.

ctx.x: Well, did y'all ever have any more than the three of you together then? That's all.

Well, did you ever? We had the three, up until, uh, Cap was about, maybe twenty-eight or thirty, or maybe thirty-three years old, something like that. Well, I got up a band over the lake, and I used to send the cap to come over and play with me over there when he was available. But I had a band over there for a long time. And, uh, between, plus playing with, uh, you remember Agnes Oce, he was a little, he was a saxophone player over here?
I never knew him. No. I heard him.
